scope: Researched leads, not an automatic addition list. Geographic seeds require active-map/coast and engine validation.
population_policy: Small/regional OpenTTD settings only, not historical census conversions. Grow only new towns towards a modest cap if necessary for a real catchment; never inflate to force profitability.

records.name: Falmouth
records.role: Atlantic mail packets, passengers and trade
records.history: Packet station by 1689; around forty packet ships in the early 1800s.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/role; coordinates need local map verification

records.name: Dover
records.history: Harbour governance chartered in 1606; longstanding passenger and cargo port.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/role; coordinates need local map verification

records.name: Holyhead
records.history: Port since at least the sixteenth century; harbour works from 1809, lighthouse 1821, customs house 1823.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/role; island geometry must be checked

records.name: Whitehaven
records.role: Coal export and Irish Sea commerce
records.history: Quay constructed in 1634 to export coal to Ireland; substantial eighteenth-century trading port.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/role; approximate gazetteer seed

records.name: Whitby
records.history: Seventeenth-century shipping expansion; major eighteenth-century shipbuilding and whale-fishery activity.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/role; estuary alignment needs verification

records.name: Viana
records.history: 1258 charter and maritime commerce; modern Viana do Castelo name dates to 1848, so use Viana for 1830.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/name; exact estuary bank needs verification

records.name: Setúbal
records.role: Sado estuary salt, fishing and trade
records.history: Medieval seaport and fishing community; first dock works in the eighteenth century, long before the modern port authority.
records.confidence: HIGH existence/role; preserve historic north estuary bank

records.name: Gijón
records.role: Old local harbour, not twentieth-century El Musel
records.history: Historic local harbour predates the 1907 commercial opening of El Musel; maritime activity must be represented at the old town.
records.confidence: HIGH settlement/old harbour; do not import modern bulk-port geography

records.name: Tarragona
records.history: Modern harbour works began in 1790; the port archive retains contemporary documentation from that date.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/works; town/harbour alignment needs verification

records.name: Cette
records.history: Port founded in 1666; period spelling Cette retained until 1928. No census-to-game population conversion claimed.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/name; peninsula and lagoon access need verification

records.name: Wismar
records.history: Thirteenth-century foundation; major Hanseatic trading centre, with retained medieval harbour basin.
records.confidence: HIGH historical existence/role; harbour-bay access needs verification

negative_controls.name: Fleetwood
negative_controls.reason: Planned-town construction began in 1836, after campaign start.

negative_controls.name: Esbjerg
negative_controls.reason: New port authorized in 1868 and opened in 1874; inappropriate 1830 maritime city.

negative_controls.name: Memel
negative_controls.reason: Already represented by Klaipėda in the active town inventory; do not duplicate historical/modern names.

negative_controls.name: Londonderry
negative_controls.reason: Already represented by Derry; its unresolved port access does not justify a duplicate town.
